color.note: Black and white, with one blue. Blue marks you and what you can do: your own messages, the primary action, what is selected, what needs you, what is done, keyboard focus. One red, for real errors only, always as the alert icon. No other colours, gradients or glows. Dark is the primary theme; light is its inverse.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and chat ground. The sidebar sits on it too, separated by a border hairline.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: One step up from bg: the assistant bubble, the composer, cards (ComputerCard, ApprovalCard, SettingsSection, lists of tasks and leads), sheets, row hover.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Two steps up: secondary buttons, menus, the avatar disc. Never a third step, and no blue text on it in the light theme (4.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and chip edges, the sidebar edge. Decorative (about 1.3:1 on bg), so never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: text fields, selects, pairing-code cells, the waiting ring in StepList, empty temperature bars. 3.1:1 or more on bg and panel in both themes; not on panel-raised.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons: 16:1 or more on bg, panel and panel-raised, 15:1 or more on accent-soft, in both themes. Also error sentences (the red is only the icon beside them), the unread dot and filled temperature bars.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: previews, timestamps, metadata, descriptions, placeholders, idle icons. On bg 5.7:1, panel 5.2:1, panel-raised 4.8:1 in both themes; on accent-soft 4.8:1 or more where the tint sits on bg (not where it sits on panel in light, 4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-fg
tokens.usage: Icons on an fg fill: the remove dot on an attachment.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one blue, as a fill: your own message bubbles, primary pill buttons (Approve, Allow for 30 min, Send, Connect a Mac, Save), the selected conversation's left marker, the Approvals count badge, the edge of a card that needs you, the focus ring. With on-accent text (5.2:1). As an edge or mark, 3.2:1 or more on every dark surface and 4.3:1 or more on every light one.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything drawn in accent (6.7:1 with on-accent).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-hover fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Blue text, links and blue icons (the done check) on bg and panel: dark 7.8:1 on bg, 7.1:1 on panel, 6.5:1 on panel-raised; light 5.2:1 on bg, 4.7:1 on panel. Not on panel-raised in light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The subtle blue tint (#2563eb at 14% in dark, 12% in light): selected rows, the selected filter chip, the chosen person at sign-in, and the Action needed pill. Text on it is fg or accent-soft-text.

tokens.name: accent-soft-text
tokens.usage: Blue text on accent-soft: Action needed, a selected chip, the current nav item. Dark 6.3:1 or more; light uses the deeper #1d4ed8 because #2563eb on the tint is only 4.0–4.4:1 (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Real errors only, and only as a mark: the alert icon, a failed step, the edge of an error card. Never text: the sentence beside it is fg. As a mark 4.4:1 or more on dark surfaces and 3.2:1 or more on light ones (as text it would fail in light, 3.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs (new channel, members, the phone sidebar).

tokens.name: bubble-assistant
tokens.usage: Assistant bubble fill: dark grey on the left (light grey in the light theme).

tokens.name: bubble-user
tokens.usage: Your own bubble fill: blue on the right, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-bubble-user
tokens.usage: Text inside your bubble: white on blue (5.2:1).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One sans-serif, Geist (Google Fonts, 400/500/600). Weight and grey carry hierarchy; size steps are few.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Ask Jarvis anything about your leads, email, or schedule.
styles.usage: The empty-chat greeting and the sign-in title. Nothing else.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Send the counter to the listing agent
styles.usage: Card titles: an approval's summary, a settings section. Also the Jarvis wordmark.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The inspection is booked for Friday at 10. I’ll remind the buyer the day before.
styles.usage: What you read in the chat: both bubbles and the composer field.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Jarvis: Counter sent to the listing agent
styles.usage: Everything around the chat: previews, step labels, SystemLines, descriptions, field text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Anything you can press or select: buttons, nav items, conversation names.

styles.name: pairing
styles.usage: PairingCode characters only, with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a tag; tight meta rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; attachment to its bubble; inside the composer box.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card internal rhythm; row padding inline; between steps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; between chat turns; phone gutters; bubble padding inline.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: SettingsSection padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop chat gutters; between sidebar groups and cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the empty-chat greeting and its example prompts.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top margin of the empty chat; space above and below the sign-in column.

radius.note: Soft: 14 to 18px on everything you see as a surface, pills on everything you press.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The one tight corner of a bubble: bottom-left on the assistant, bottom-right on the user.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inside a card: the browser screenshot, image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, nav items, menus, document chips, pairing-code cells, diff boxes, the people picker.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: ComputerCard, ApprovalCard, SettingsSection, StepList, ErrorState, task and lead lists, the today summary, the voice strip.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Message bubbles and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, tag, filter chip, select and text field.

shadow.note: Flat. Cards in the flow have no shadow; only what floats over the chat does.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, the ComputerCard while docked over the transcript, sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on everything focusable: a 2px bg gap, then 2px of solid accent blue (3.2:1 or more on every surface in both themes). Box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

size.note: Fixed measures the layout is built from.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width on desktop.

tokens.name: size-chat
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the chat column.

tokens.name: size-bubble
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a bubble, a StepList and a SystemLine, of the chat column.

tokens.name: size-composer
tokens.usage: Composer height at one line; its corner radius is half of this.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, send and mic, text fields.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards and rows (keys, read aloud, row menus).

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum row height on touch screens.

tokens.name: size-thumb
tokens.usage: Image attachment thumbnails.

tokens.name: size-computer-sm
tokens.usage: ComputerCard docked and small.

tokens.name: size-computer-lg
tokens.usage: ComputerCard opened.

tokens.name: size-sheet
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a sheet or dialog; full width on a phone.

tokens.name: size-signin
tokens.usage: Width of the sign-in column.

duration.note: Motion says something is happening; it never decorates. Every entry here has a reduce-motion fallback (README, Motion).

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Hover and press colour and opacity changes.

tokens.name: dur-tick
tokens.usage: The blue done check drawing itself when a step finishes.

tokens.name: dur-step
tokens.usage: A new StepList row rising 4px and fading in.

tokens.name: dur-word
tokens.usage: Each streamed word fading in.

tokens.name: dur-word-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between words that arrive in one chunk (capped at 12 words).

tokens.name: dur-dots
tokens.usage: One cycle of the typing dots.

tokens.name: dur-dots-offset
tokens.usage: How far each typing dot runs behind the one before.

tokens.name: dur-live
tokens.usage: The live dot breathing while the browser is in use or the mic records.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets (new channel, members), menus and the phone sidebar sliding in.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: words, steps, ticks, sheets.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Loops: typing dots, the live dot.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: sheets and menus closing.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. The only change a disabled control makes.
